name: claude_code_mcp_failures
description: An MCP server failed to connect 3 or more times in 30 minutes.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COALESCE(server_name, mcp_server_name, '(redacted)') AS server, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'mcp_server_connection' AND status = 'failed' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
